visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with brown hair and silver-rimmed glasses stands in a brightly lit indoor hallway. He wears a crisp white long-sleeved shirt with a long tie and black trousers. He points with both index fingers towards a wall covered in colorful, stylized posters. His expression is friendly and engaging. (2) A vibrant graphic animation appears featuring the text 'Re: CURU' in purple and yellow 3D letters over a bright green radiating background with floating geometric fragments. (3) The man is seated indoors; a stylist's hand is visible using yellow clips and a red brush to style his dark hair. The lighting is soft and focused on his head and shoulders. (4) A close-up shot shows the man's hand with long nails being painted with silver glitter polish. A small brush is carefully applying the color. (5) In a dimly lit dressing room or backstage area, the man is seen from behind examining a black shirt on a rack before the scene cuts to him wearing the white shirt. (6) A detailed close-up focuses on the white fabric of his shirt, revealing embroidered Japanese text that blends into the white texture. (7) The man walks confidently outdoors on a gray pavement towards the camera, waving with his right hand. He is in a public area with blurred figures of people and urban buildings in the background. (8) He holds up a 'Weekly Shonen Jump' magazine featuring characters like Goku, smiling at the camera. A person with blonde hair stands partially behind him against a backdrop of colorful event posters. (9) A laptop screen displays black and white manga panels, specifically showing characters and alchemy circles from 'Fullmetal Alchemist'. (10) An extreme close-up of the man's silver glasses reveals a small decorative cross on the temple. (11) Multiple close-up shots showcase his hands adorned with several heavy silver rings, including one with a large red oval stone. (12) The man adjusts his white tie in front of a mirror in a professional studio setting with gray backgrounds. (13) Under dramatic red and blue studio lighting, the man poses for photos. A photographer's back is visible as they hold a camera. (14) A fast montage of high-quality portrait photos follows, showing the man in various poses with saturated pink and blue backgrounds. (15) Back in the studio, the man laughs and smiles warmly at the camera, looking relaxed. He ends by squatting and posing with his hand over his face, showing off his silver jewelry.
